faqs.question: How long does a kiosk or PWA project take?
faqs.answer: Most projects go from kickoff to a live, testable version in a few weeks, depending on how much content and how many languages are involved. We map your existing materials first, so there's no blank-page delay.

faqs.question: Do you build in Bahasa Malaysia and Tamil too?
faqs.answer: Yes — every project we've shipped supports English alongside Bahasa Malaysia and/or Tamil or Chinese depending on the audience, built in from day one rather than added later.

faqs.question: Can I edit the content myself after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes — that's the point of the CMS dashboard. No code, no waiting on us for small changes; you log in and edit content, schedules and pricing directly.

faqs.question: What happens after launch?
faqs.answer: Every project ships with a browser-based admin so your team can update it directly. We also monitor the infrastructure it runs on and are on call for anything beyond day-to-day edits.

faqs.question: Do you only build kiosks, or web apps too?
faqs.answer: Both, plus native iOS/Android apps and WhatsApp automation where it fits. The kiosk, the PWA and the admin dashboard are usually built from the same content, so nothing gets duplicated.
